ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed JOUR 410 should not register for JOUR 215. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You will be removed from the course if you have not met the pre-reqs listed.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
